fieldValues.title: Package checks: flexible now, strict later
fieldValues.decision_question: How strictly should the Inv 43 check require declared package dependencies?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's working session on 2026-10-10 (the owner was away from a computer); awaiting the owner's ratification. The check reads packageDependencies by namespace label rather than by package id (RFC-044 [R7]/[R10]). Cross-package base-type resolution and a package distribution process do not exist yet.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: A: flexible now. B: strict now (may flag valid repositories). Chosen: A now, then B when possible.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Be flexible now: the check reports nothing (or advisory only) until base types can be resolved across packages; then move to the strict check that requires a dependency on the base type owning package.
fieldValues.rationale: We move towards stricter package resolution and management, but until there is a proper package distribution process, strictness would flag valid repositories.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a package distribution process exists (RFC-047) and base types resolve across packages.
fieldValues.next_steps: WG Third-party ready does A: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/issues/1173 . B is filed as a follow-up blocked on package distribution.
